name: push-banner help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:push-banner. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Pull main in
entries.text: Brings main's newer commits into this branch, so it can merge.

entries.title: Hand to Claude
entries.text: Gives this to headless Claude Code on the VPS to sort out.

entries.title: Hide (every device)
entries.text: Hides it from the banner on every device.

entries.title: Merge
entries.text: Merges this PR — only once it's up to date with main and CI is green.

entries.title: Repair on the VPS
entries.text: Fixes this checkout on the VPS (a veto call).

entries.title: Remove from Pull failed
entries.text: Takes it off the Pull failed list on every device.

entries.title: Repair all on the VPS
entries.text: Fixes every broken checkout on the VPS.

entries.title: Hand failed pulls to Claude
entries.text: Every pull that conflicts goes to headless Claude Code on the VPS by itself.

entries.title: Pull main into all
entries.text: Brings main into every branch that's behind.

entries.title: Pull main into the group
entries.text: Brings main's newer commits into every branch in this group.

entries.title: Hand failures to Mosses
entries.text: Failures go to Mosses (Claude Code on the VPS) by itself.

entries.title: Any shell command
entries.text: Lets the fixer run any shell command. Leave it off unless you trust it.

entries.title: Branches not on main
entries.text: Shows “Branches not on main”. Part of Build Breaker.

entries.title: Auto-land finished builds
entries.text: Builds with every step done land by themselves: a plain script merges main in, opens the PR and starts CI. No AI, no tokens.

entries.title: Wait for UI Review
entries.text: On: a PR waits until you approve its screenshots in UI Review, then merges by itself. Off: UI Review never holds a merge.

entries.title: Land now
entries.text: Lands this build at the next round (within 3 minutes), ahead of the others. Releases a hold.

entries.title: Hold
entries.text: Keeps this finished build from landing until you release it.

entries.title: Release
entries.text: Lets a held build land again.

entries.title: Merge queue
entries.text: Opens the merge queue: every ready PR in the order it merges, each tested once.

entries.title: Jump to front
entries.text: Puts this PR first in the merge queue. Only your own click can do this.

entries.title: Remove from queue
entries.text: Takes this PR out of the queue until its next commit. The ones behind it get retested without it.

entries.title: Add back
entries.text: Puts a kicked-out PR back in the queue as it is, to be tested again.

entries.title: Add to queue
entries.text: Puts a PR you took out back in the merge queue.

entries.title: Add to Home
entries.text: Shows the merge queue as a card on Home.

entries.title: Merge queue
entries.text: On: each PR is tested once on top of main and the PRs ahead of it, then merges with no second run.

entries.title: Merge conflicts
entries.text: Open PRs that conflict with main in code, checked every queue round. Each stays here and on the banner until it is resolved.

entries.title: Fix conflicts now
entries.text: Starts a job that merges main into the PR, resolves the conflicts, reruns its checks and pushes, so the PR rejoins the merge queue. Only your own click starts it.
